headline: King Harris warns creator 607 unc to stop playing due to real-life risks
body: DJ Akademiks reports King Harris has warned content creator 607 unc to cease playing a track, citing potential real-life consequences like physical harm. The post, shared on September 6, 2026, highlights Harris's concern that the song's content could lead to dangerous situations. With over 544 comments and 2,322 likes, the post has sparked debate about online safety and the responsibilities of creators.
